selection_rule: E_miner: train rows split chronologically 90/10; model trained on first 90% (all <2016); last 10% of TRAIN scored out-of-sample; legit rows ranked by ensemble probability; top-scoring legit emitted as hard negatives. Val/test rows never enter the miner fit, scoring slice, or mined set; no test label is read in mission_train.py (test labels are never scored until final eval).
miner_reproducible: seed 42, deterministic -> rerun reproduces identical ids
